events.text: The hook blocks cloning Usetantra repos, so I won't do that. Instead I'll check the published-deck patch against the live index.html in a plain scratch directory.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect patch headers and README index
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches; for f in tantra-webinar-deck/*.patch webinar-deck/*.patch; do echo "== $f"; grep -E "^(From |Subject|diff --git|index )" $f | head -12; grep -c "^[-+][^-+]" $f; done; grep -n "deck" README.md | head
